params.1273: Craft an air rune at the Air Altar.
params.1274: You must have completed Rune Mysteries, and you will need an air talisman to access the altar.
params.1275: Acquire some rune or pure essence.
params.1277: Use the talisman on the ruins to enter, and click on the altar to bind your essence into runes.
params.2225: Binding runes gives Runecrafting experience. At higher Runecrafting levels you have a chance to create multiple runes from a single piece of essence.
